IBBA Segev Player Box

Source: R/ibba_segev.R
ibba_segev_player_box.Rd

Per-player box score of a finished game, plus a team-credited line per side.

Endpoint: GET https://stats.segevstats.com/realtimestat_heb/api/?method=getBoxScore

Usage

ibba_segev_player_box(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(integer required): Segev game id (e.g. 50 = Hapoel Be'er Sheva vs Maccabi Tel Aviv, 2025-26 round 1): segev_game_id in ibba_games.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerSegev game id (key space: one flat sequence across seasons and competitions); equals the IBBA ibba_games segev_game_id from 2025-26. Not an IBBA game id.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game: home or away (the feed's homeTeam / awayTeam; an action's parameters.team 1 = home, 2 = away).
team_idintegerSegev team id of the side (key space: Segev teams, stable across seasons). Not an IBBA team-season id; null on game-level actions.
row_typecharacterplayer (one player's line) or team (actions credited to the team and no player, such as team rebounds and turnovers).
player_idintegerSegev player id (key space: Segev players, stable across seasons: Jaylen Hoard = 1000 in games 50 and 419); null on team lines and on actions without a player. Not an IBBA player-season id.
jersey_numberintegerJersey number as an integer.
starterlogicalTrue when the player was in the starting five.
on_courtlogicalTrue when the player was on court at the final buzzer or the feed's last state.
minutescharacterTime played as 'mm:ss'.
seconds_playedintegerTime played in seconds, derived from minutes.
plus_minusintegerPlus-minus while the player was on court, signed.
fg2mintegerTwo-point field goals made.
fg2_missedintegerTwo-point field goals MISSED (not attempted; attempts = made + missed, verified against the IBBA box score).
fg3mintegerThree-point field goals made.
fg3_missedintegerThree-point field goals MISSED (not attempted).
ftmintegerFree throws made.
ft_missedintegerFree throws MISSED (not attempted).
drebintegerDefensive rebounds.
orebintegerOffensive rebounds.
foulsintegerFouls committed (the feed's f; equals the IBBA fouls).
fouls_drawnintegerFouls drawn (the feed's f_drawn; equals the IBBA fouls_drawn).
stealsintegerSteals made by the player or team.
turnoversintegerTurnovers committed by the player or team.
assistsintegerAssists credited to the player or team.
blocksintegerShots the player or team blocked.
blocks_againstintegerOwn shots that were blocked.
fast_break_ptsintegerFast-break points; for a team total it equals the P of the feed's 'P of N' fast-break stat.
second_chance_ptsintegerSecond-chance points (scored after an offensive rebound).
ptsintegerPoints scored by the player or side (free throws included).
valintegerEfficiency rating (the feed's rate; equals the IBBA VAL).
deflectionsintegerDeflections (count of deflection actions).
recoveriesintegerThe feed's rec count; unverified, probably loose-ball recoveries.
dunksintegerDunks made by the player or side.
offensive_fouls_drawnintegerOffensive fouls drawn (charges taken); inferred.
and_onesintegerAnd-one plays (a made basket plus a foul); inferred.
vpsdoubleThe feed's vps ratio with two decimals; its definition is unverified (it matches neither points per shot nor rate per minute).
fg2aintegerTwo-point field goals attempted, derived as made + missed.
fg3aintegerThree-point field goals attempted, derived as made + missed.
ftaintegerFree throws attempted, derived as made + missed.

Details

The ibba_segev_*() wrappers read Segev Stats, the live-stats vendor behind basket.co.il's game pages (stats.segevstats.com/realtimestat_heb/api/, a JSON-RPC API served as text/html): the game header, rosters, box score, period scores and play-by-play with shot coordinates, from 2025-26. They mirror sdv-py's ibba_segev_* wrappers of the same names: same arguments, the same snake_case columns and types, one row per sdv-py row.

Unofficial and unsupported. The API is keyless, unofficial and not documented for outside use. Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host (429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried three times, a 500 is not); only finished games are read.

Games and ids. game_id is one flat Segev id space across seasons AND competitions (men's Winner League, Winner Cup, women's, Leumit, youth, school and pre-season games), so read competition from ibba_segev_game_info(). There is no game list: league game ids come from ibba_games() segev_game_id (2025-26 on; see ibba_segev_game_crosswalk()). Segev team and player ids are stable across seasons (Jaylen Hoard = player 1000 in games 50 and 419), unlike the IBBA season registrations, and are not IBBA ids.

Play-by-play. Actions name the player by Segev id and by JERSEY number, score reads away-home, and shot x / y are one half-court frame (x 0-1470 across, basket near 735; y out from the baseline, rim near 112-140); which sideline is x = 0 and the metric scale are unverified. Segev renamed its team game stats between 2025-26 and 2026-27; the frames unify them. start_time is the scheduled tip-off in Israel local time (POSIXct, tz Asia/Jerusalem; the feed carries no offset).

Errors are classed conditions, never a warning plus an empty frame: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, "game not found", a finished game with no actions), hoopR_bad_request (HTTP 400 / 422, or a game_id that is not a positive integer) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: another status, a transport error, an empty or non-JSON body, an error or changed envelope, a body for another game, a game that is not final). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

Other IBBA Segev Functions: ibba_segev_game_info(), ibba_segev_pbp(), ibba_segev_period_scores(), ibba_segev_rosters(), ibba_segev_team_box()
